name: TRIFIC Green USD I-Reit
source: StockAnalysis cash flow statement NSE:TRFC (data from S&P Global Market Intelligence), fiscal year ended 31 March 2026, published in USD millions to two decimals and stored in absolute USD. Capital expenditure is the acquisition of real estate assets line, stored negative as this dataset stores capex. Financing cash flow is the sum of the share issuance and dividend lines the source prints separately.

rows.label: Free Cash Flow
rows.derivedFrom: Free Cash Flow = Operating Cash Flow + Capital Expenditure (capex stored negative)

derivation.note: rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures, not printed in the source
